title: Upstream Semantic Knowledge Runtime Operations Audit
principle: Naikkan pengetahuan menjadi data model; jangan menurunkan pengetahuan menjadi control flow.
changes: Removed direct imports from deleted relationMembership and relationalSequence foundations in semanticDataflowKnowledge.ts.
Introduced a private SemanticKnowledgeSelectionOperationsInterface and a frozen typed operation object owned by the semantic knowledge domain.
Moved assignment-effect, assignment-reference, parser-evidence, data-flow-role, and optional-guard resolution behind domain-owned operations.
Preserved SemanticPresence as a continuation-bearing ADT with continueWith handlers.
Kept packages/core/src/types/upstream/collections.ts empty and did not recreate generic relation foundation modules.
known_remaining_findings: This is a focused upstream migration, not a full migration of all upstream, CLI, manifest, and IR consumers.

The private domain lookup still uses host-language array lookup and closed-union assumptions internally; a future model pass can replace those implementation details with explicit typed lookup judgments without introducing a generic collection foundation.
The wider workspace build is not asserted as passing: the existing build.log records 230 unresolved imports from an older build snapshot and there are no local node_modules in this workspace.
